preconditions: Subtotal equals integer unit price multiplied by nonnegative integer quantity
No shipping, minimum order, discount or tier-price rule applies
source: Controlled fixtures in tests/fixtures/python and tests/fixtures/web; implementation based on repository 2c88c54ed58bc167c4a4fceeb52e5e2027cb4705 plus this working-tree change
expected: 125 cents x 3 units = 375; zero units = 0; negative quantity is rejected
reproduction: Run tests/run-portability.py: inject quantity + 1 into the cart subtotal, then run each installed quality helper
rootCause: Adding one to the count charges for an unrequested unit; nonzero and zero boundary cases violate the same invariant
fix: Multiply by the actual validated count; keep domain rules distinct from array-index adjustments
